d9adfb0e13fd9a0bfd48d0bd21ce25a","modified":1612429030002,"text":"身为弟子若故意，轻蔑如是之上师，"},{"heading":0,"id":"fa328855d35c76edbd3e8941bb373e05","modified":1612429030002,"text":"则已轻侮一切佛，故彼恒时受痛苦。"}],"collapsed":false,"heading":0,"id":"00225d17f11f556cde87e031e9f6d189","modified":1612429030002,"text":"总说"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"84b95286208e62d3155a99cc21888c1e","modified":1612429030002,"text":"诽谤上师之弟子，患传染病危害病，"},{"heading":0,"id":"18d97c9fb554e4b75b5b3b440d045fc9","modified":1612429030002,"text":"中邪瘟疫染诸毒，大愚之人依此死。"},{"heading":0,"id":"2df0575ed760e1ee73547535b8611cf3","modified":1612429030002,"text":"遭受恶王及毒蛇，水火空行与盗贼，"},{"heading":0,"id":"16e2d6efd5b29e7620e4e67f39728107","modified":1612429030002,"text":"妖魔鬼怪众所杀，堕入无间之地狱。"}],"collapsed":false,"heading":0,"id":"6d902aa5d9f8e92242eb085b199b369e","modified":1612429030002,"text":"别说"}],"collapsed":false,"heading":0,"id":"7962a58b08009ebf2b921a1bbf37fefe","modified":1612429030002,"text":"杜绝轻蔑诽谤"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"1d1c779131d9ca9a356453c63a6a208a","modified":1612429030002,"text":"何时何地永切莫，扰乱金刚上师心， ","modified":1612429030002,"text":"如是而为之合理性"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"c85133ab51c4013907e3ac6c43502e85","modified":1612429030002,"text":"恒时护己之誓言，恒时供养诸善逝， "},{"heading":0,"id":"8b27b252c2f556e1cc39604dd728fae6","modified":1612429030002,"text":"是故一切精勤者，切莫违背师言教。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"ce5348d4477c2a3966962e1cc6656f66","modified":1612429030002,"text":"依教奉行"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"0aa575ef23c2978965ea30c0d42cd0a6","modified":1612429030002,"text":"上师财物护如命，师爱之人亦如师，"},{"heading":0,"id":"69860d45cdcdd606fd999b9f8eb558f4","modified":1612429030002,"text":"师之眷属如亲友，专心致志恒思维。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"fc90f01b35135bd867de73189e126e1a","modified":1612429030002,"text":"如何对待上师之物品及眷属"},{"children":[{"children":[{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"a40953eceeb2130dc14d81c9c83219f0","modified":1612429030002,"text":"坐于高垫与先行，头上带有围巾等，"},{"heading":0,"id":"85b64bb86673a65426dd647949db74bd","modified":1612429030002,"text":"双足放于坐垫上，双手叉腰皆莫为。"},{"heading":0,"id":"2b4407103867bc24dfeee7232dee1c93","modified":1612429030002,"text":"上师如若已起身，切莫躺卧与端坐，"},{"heading":0,"id":"0280bb650f35752efee047c340ffaabc","modified":1612429030002,"text":"恒时圆满而精通，此等承侍上师事。 "},{"heading":0,"id":"4c3dc17b8347609e93cbe406f8b2f0a7","modified":1612429030002,"text":"随意口吐唾液等，坐垫之上伸双脚， "},{"heading":0,"id":"48630e3be5ceb191b90f85917e1bae6a","modified":1612429030002,"text":"轻拍缓捶与辩论，上师之前皆莫为。 "},{"heading":0,"id":"bf58e1b3b8a2cb28ba0c459fbfb1db88","modified":1612429030002,"text":"搓手唱歌与跳舞，弹奏乐器亦莫为。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"448a677f6887785c193cef6168339d0e","modified":1612429030002,"text":"上师能见近处之威仪"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"f6ef88af47903dadfeb76764a403e23b","modified":1612429030002,"text":"谈论诸多闲杂语，师闻附近切莫为。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"100a73564c144b68a0d84be465e10bf4","modified":1612429030002,"text":"上师能闻近处之威仪"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"ba3aa827b08937920a19de4c9a37e074","modified":1612429030002,"text":"禁止非理之行为"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"b0e1ed72751d8ba3cfbad8cbf40bfb2a","modified":1612429030002,"text":"应当恭敬垫上起，以恭敬心而端坐。"},{"heading":0,"id":"23b9a1afdd3499881c1a1a4812bb5105","modified":1612429030002,"text":"夜晚过河恐怖途，得许可后当前行。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"6c3ef42e1bc97d94f939ba07e4b143d9","modified":1612429030002,"text":"依止合理之行为"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"dd9f7878da42d94fca8e2b84961a6f0f","modified":1612429030002,"text":"上师能见之眼前，具智慧者身扭转，"},{"heading":0,"id":"fa85c26f59505a24afdcd950186b25f8","modified":1612429030002,"text":"倚靠柱子不应为，亦莫抻拉手指节。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"9d5eb5a40ca60deace63289ff79743d8","modified":1612429030002,"text":"宣说其他所禁止之非理威仪"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"33dab6f8b1a50e5f6c7e588c93685610","modified":1612429030002,"text":"平时的一切行为"},{"children":[{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"6cd039adb5ed9d0ec64581478175be30","modified":1612429030002,"text":"洗足以及沐浴身，擦拭以及搓揉等，"},{"heading":0,"id":"58a456ca333a3cc0408dd2083867c0af","modified":1612429030002,"text":"首先顶礼再为之，最后亦可随意行。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"14322852f7f1d3beedaf68b2c7b453fd","modified":1612429030002,"text":"身体承侍之差别"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"0f17863277c44d165d86c1e2bd2757ca","modified":1612429030002,"text":"倘若称呼上师名，师名之后加尊者，"},{"heading":0,"id":"a90089a81a5a1cae58833caa431d382b","modified":1612429030002,"text":"为令他人恭敬之，言说尊称之敬语。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"8242f8f369f195ae283f63e1f10899c9","modified":1612429030002,"text":"语言承侍之差别"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"c6bae3e30060a3fb23d23787cd15ef2d","modified":1612429030002,"text":"身语承侍之差别"},{"children":[{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"289067b00da3c0e5e9011651160a862a","modified":1612429030002,"text":"请求上师予吩咐，口中当说谨遵命，"},{"heading":0,"id":"d523d4b811989718f03ad8bf346da456","modified":1612429030002,"text":"双手合十不散乱，洗耳恭听师吩咐。"},{"heading":0,"id":"55473c0a12e869273f077a488988870f","modified":1612429030002,"text":"发笑以及咳嗽等，应当用手捂住口，"},{"heading":0,"id":"5c0fc51c8435e45f00b4b548d042f264","modified":1612429030002,"text":"事情成办圆满后，当以柔语作陈述。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"313c9375643eabae6fc5e481d0a0525a","modified":1612429030002,"text":"依教奉行时断除我慢"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"462f6142a5b61319b86759ed3f6766df","modified":1612429030002,"text":"上师之前调柔住，衣等仪表当整洁，"},{"heading":0,"id":"78f97416af8576f6c69f92b7da006dba","modified":1612429030002,"text":"双膝跪地手合掌，欲闻法等祈三遍。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"bcc7fcde033355bf0348321b96f61eea","modified":1612429030002,"text":"恭听佛法等时断除我慢"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"6c0cf763e50cf20673d7cbc7f946edc2","modified":1612429030002,"text":"承侍一切行为中，当无贡高我慢心，"},{"heading":0,"id":"01c225422aa55f0135a79668e00b6985","modified":1612429030002,"text":"知惭畏惧护根门，当以新媳姿态住。"},{"heading":0,"id":"00be6ec271114e30520c7a9203cdc92e","modified":1612429030002,"text":"娇媚姿态等诸行，上师之前当断除，"},{"heading":0,"id":"3ccbe648989b76daf7120a83c549440f","modified":1612429030002,"text":"其余类似之事宜，自己观察当舍弃。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"68c7869ea87a4d033c589803d4da41a3","modified":1612429030002,"text":"平时威仪中断除我慢"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"6060c542b99e153584cf4dd71fc1879c","modified":1612429030002,"text":"断除我慢"},{"children":[{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"ef3e133b6f4fa8ab38f14ac06fd318f8","modified":1612429030002,"text":"开光灌顶与火施，摄受弟子传佛法，"},{"heading":0,"id":"f8e08e34c400327984e0bf2d30a53808","modified":1612429030002,"text":"上师若在彼境内，未经开许前莫为。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"29f5d4be372231ca17562923cff5456d","modified":1612429030002,"text":"饶益他众时请求开许"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"8da1c06bd4f2d904137edb359c9c8412","modified":1612429030002,"text":"作开光等所得物，悉皆供养上师尊，"},{"heading":0,"id":"9582946c2aac1a022510ed1c684a0bd8","modified":1612429030002,"text":"上师接受供品后，其余随意自享用。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"b9e053b75922d0e4db1af97eb871f1a2","modified":1612429030002,"text":"所得供养敬献上师"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"66b9ffa90e14f97c517f501a58f83887","modified":1612429030002,"text":"不摄上师之弟子，于上师前当禁止，"},{"heading":0,"id":"94088fcae2d629a93a7f0f9a22d16bc5","modified":1612429030002,"text":"自之弟子承侍己，起立顶礼等行为。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"aaea9b33cd58f178433caa9dd3f9af27","modified":1612429030002,"text":"于上师前不允许他人对自己承侍"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"920f0e959cd1826745aa4628903669ae","modified":1612429030002,"text":"供养上师任何物，以及上师赐何物，"},{"heading":0,"id":"438dcd3efab068c30e9a0a892c76de63","modified":1612429030002,"text":"具有智慧之弟子，应当顶礼双手接。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"7044c34f510443fbfaa7ae173191b834","modified":1612429030002,"text":"身体威仪毕恭毕敬"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"f069f8f114ee55a006299d84b8a98f5c","modified":1612429030002,"text":"不忘正知与正念，自之行为谨慎者，"},{"heading":0,"id":"0fb9135c9f550eeec7814d4d882d0a12","modified":1612429030002,"text":"道友行为越轨时，当以喜心互制止。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"48a4bd9e5b021e4c739301ba9643e746","modified":1612429030002,"text":"附加内容："}],"collapsed":true,"heading":0,"id":"75ab4370f8611446d3f105a038709d5c","modified":1612429030002,"text":"不能自作主张"}],"collapsed":false,"heading":0,"id":"86837129eab6605b41175cb8e0b6ddfd","modified":1612429030002,"text":"恭敬之方式"}],"collapsed":false,"heading":0,"id":"784f0c74b666b6ffb371a2c53b0be811","modified":1612429030002,"text":"广说依师之方式"}],"collapsed":false,"heading":3,"id":"148ca37ab9a86139a1e11e9cfcf69cda","modified":1612429030002,"text":"总说依止之方式"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"9d535e4b6f736221956a6e674ed5cb1a","modified":1612429030002,"text":"病人对于事上师，虽未顶礼求开许，"},{"heading":0,"id":"0928566209bed1e88f8acd281e3cab1c","modified":1612429030002,"text":"已做一切遮止行，具善心者无罪过。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":3,"id":"fdd3f15918a95b5048302ea442e110a7","modified":1612429030002,"text":"特殊依止之方式"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"ef20de31e796c069ba691e2e17167870","modified":1612429030002,"text":"于此多言何必要，能令师喜皆当为，"},{"heading":0,"id":"3ba860865b60eabf15e74608cf9a0d0f","modified":1612429030002,"text":"师不喜事悉断除，于此应当尽力行。"},{"heading":0,"id":"ea85885e664facd6b5e4f9b7fe096825","modified":1612429030002,"text":"所谓悉地随师生，此乃金刚持亲言，"},{"heading":0,"id":"2e64e74102da92db2e6490cad0be32bf","modified":1612429030002,"text":"了知此后诸行为，竭尽全力令师喜。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":3,"id":"07f927b5a607b8ce77fbb1f96feb3e3d","modified":1612429030002,"text":"依止方式之摄义"}],"collapsed":false,"heading":2,"id":"bf2cd8f2f6f61244427bafb18373832e","modified":1612429030002,"text":"依师之方式"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"a173ac80cefe6225277f1c1f2fc2d0b6","modified":1612429030002,"text":"意乐清净之弟子，已于三宝前皈依，"},{"heading":0,"id":"3c6b5c6d7ed7731573525f03c99c5973","modified":1612429030002,"text":"此部事师五十颂，应当施彼读诵也。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":2,"id":"7be69c53261aa2d8843d30443fbc54b8","modified":1612429030002,"text":"依止之时间"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"72bf231f128c5147a5887c7badb005d6","modified":1612429030002,"text":"传授欲学密咒等，令彼堪为妙法器，"},{"heading":0,"id":"34a61573aea0ab0ed855dfb97a657fc1","modified":1612429030002,"text":"后当读诵与受持，密宗十四根本戒。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":2,"id":"8cd3ce14a0f95f5b9552e031702da96f","modified":1612429030002,"text":"如何堪为法器"}],"collapsed":false,"heading":1,"id":"2c9e02857b4e57462fa7ac73a5b8191d","modified":1612429030002,"text":"论义"},{"children":[{"heading":0,"id":"e6469aecaf56a028482db74ff46b21d0","modified":1612429030002,"text":"为利随学师弟子，造此无垢之论典，"},{"heading":0,"id":"dd431bf04c90f69fde7ee0b60f61ddfb","modified":1612429030002,"text":"以我所积诸善根，祈愿众生速成佛。"}],"collapsed":true,"heading":1,"id":"1c2b80f9fb1c0de8529a99e7b38fba5e","modified":1612429030002,"text":"末义"}],"structure":"right","theme":"fruit"}
